verdict.rationale: Cerebras provides a Quickstart with copyable code snippets (cerebras-docs-1,17) and a Cloud Console playground for trying prompts without a key (cerebras-docs-2), which offers some interactive exploration. However, a probe for a standard interactive API reference (OpenAPI/Swagger spec) returned 404 on all candidate paths (cerebras-probe-3), and there is no evidence of an in-browser 'try it' API explorer with runnable request/response examples akin to Swagger UI or Postman-style docs. missing for 10: a dedicated interactive API reference page (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger explorer) with live runnable request/response examples, and independent confirmation of its usability.
